title: Training Institute Franchise Opportunity
name: Chrysaalis, 21 Franchisees, Est'd in 2004, Bengaluru HQ
description: Chrysaalis i-Math India Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru-based private limited company focused on educational support services, with a core specialization in mathematics for young children. - The company provides mathematics programs for children from nursery to Grade 2, designed to make learning fun and enjoyable while helping children overcome their fear of mathematics. - The business develops and delivers educational programs, learning content, and support materials, including books, brochures, and other mathematics learning resources. - The company operates through a franchise model, offering state-level master franchises in select Indian states. - Revenue is primarily generated through franchise fees, with attractive commissions for master franchisees and no ongoing royalty fees. - The brand differentiates itself through its focused mathematics curriculum, structured franchisee training, and backend support provided by the central team. - The business currently has approximately 600 active students, with an average of around 30 students per centre. - The model offers an opportunity for franchise partners and investors looking to participate in the education sector through a structured mathematics-focused program. - The company has an incorporation and GST certificate.
